decision: Required to start from the Pit Lane.
event_name: Williams Martini Racing Document 30 Date 29 July 2018 Time 12:40 2018 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 July The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 29), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Parts have been changed to those of a different specification and changes have been made to the setup of the suspension whilst the car was under Parc Fermé conditions.
offence: Breach of Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start from the Pit Lane.
reason: As the parts are of a different specification to those used originally in qualifying and the setup of the suspension has also been changed the competitor is required to start from the pit lane and should follow the procedures laid out in Article 36.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 36.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 30 2018 Hungarian Grand Prix Offence Car 18 Change Of Parts Setup
